introduction_markdown: Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL questions. Section I is designed to be answered in 1 hour and Section II in 1 1/2 hours; you are advised to divide your time accordingly. In Section II answer EITHER a, b and c OR d, e and f of each question. For your guidance the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation of your answers. In calculations you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Where necessary, assume: the acceleration due to gravity on the surface of the earth, $g = 10\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$; the speed of light in air, $c = 3.0\times10^{8}\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$; the charge on an electron, $e = 1.6\times10^{-19}\,\mathrm{C}$. Calculators are allowed.
enonce_intro_markdown:
Figure 4 shows a simple pulley system used by a builder to lift a bag of cement of mass $50\,\mathrm{kg}$ to a height of $4\,\mathrm{m}$ by applying an effort of $300\,\mathrm{N}$.

![fig-1](gce-ol-physics-2024-p2-officiel-cameroun_exercice_6_fig_1.png)

*Figure 4*

figures.legende: Pulley system with three pulleys: two small and large fixed pulleys at the top and one movable pulley carrying the 50 kg bag of cement; the effort of 300 N is applied on the free end of the rope.

incertitudes: Le sujet n'imprime pas de total par question : les totaux (`points` de l'exercice) sont la somme des points imprimés bloc par bloc (Section I : 6+4+8+6+9+7 = 40 ; Section II : 20 par question, soit 100 au total).

Les schémas, diagrammes et graphes demandés à l'élève (tracé de graphe, diagramme de rayons, champ électrique ou magnétique, tension d'entrée et de sortie, schéma de montage) ne sont pas produits comme figures du corrigé : ils sont décrits dans le corrigé (axes, points clés, forme).

Figure 4 : le nombre de brins qui soutiennent la poulie mobile est lu à 3 (brin gauche venant de la grande poulie fixe, brin droit remontant vers la petite poulie fixe, et brin fixé en haut du bloc mobile). Le rapport de vitesses VR = 3, et donc le rendement de 55,6 %, reposent sur cette lecture du schéma ; vérifié par le travail : 2000 J utiles pour 300 x 12 = 3600 J fournis.

questions.enonce_markdown: What is the velocity ratio of the machine? *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The velocity ratio equals the **number of rope sections supporting the movable pulley (the load)**. In Figure 4, **three sections of rope** carry the movable pulley and the load, so

**$\text{VR} = 3$.**

(The effort moves three times as far as the load: $3 \times 4 = 12\,\mathrm{m}$.)

questions.enonce_markdown: Calculate the weight of the bag of cement. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
$W = mg = 50 \times 10 = 500\,\mathrm{N}$

**The weight of the bag is $500\,\mathrm{N}$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Calculate the mechanical advantage of the pulley system. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
$\text{MA} = \dfrac{\text{load}}{\text{effort}} = \dfrac{500}{300} = 1.67$

**$\text{MA} \approx 1.67$** (no unit: it is a ratio of two forces).

questions.enonce_markdown: Calculate the efficiency of the pulley system. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
$\text{efficiency} = \dfrac{\text{MA}}{\text{VR}} \times 100\% = \dfrac{1.667}{3} \times 100\% = 55.6\%$

Check with work: useful work done on the load $= 500 \times 4 = 2000\,\mathrm{J}$; work done by the effort $= 300 \times 12 = 3600\,\mathrm{J}$; efficiency $= \dfrac{2000}{3600} \times 100\% = 55.6\%$.

**The efficiency is about $56\%$.**
